limitations: The 2-game raw replay sample per policy is descriptive and cannot estimate generalization by itself.
Full metadata win/margin summaries use all 1,017 observed account episode rows, but raw replay mechanics are sampled.
Action fingerprint equality across only two games is evidence of a fixed tape; inequality does not prove robust state adaptation.
sampling_contract.ours: Two newest public completed episodes, one per seat where available, from every one of 22 account submissions.
sampling_contract.top25: Two newest public completed episodes, one per seat where available, from each team's highest publicScore active submission in the pinned snapshot.
